details: A payload is bounded when every string has .maxLength(n) or .maxChars(n), every array .maxItems(n), and it holds no record (export name: chat).
message: Unreliable signal chat.bubble has no bound on its payload size; Roblox drops an unreliable payload over 900 bytes without an error.
name: unreliable-signal-payload-unbounded
suggestion: Bound the payload schema, or make the signal reliable.

details: Largest binary frame, 4-byte header included (export name: trail).
message: Unreliable signal fx.trail can carry up to 2312 bytes, over Roblox's 900-byte unreliable limit; larger payloads are dropped without an error.
name: unreliable-signal-payload-too-large
suggestion: Lower the payload's maxLength / maxItems bounds, split it, or make the signal reliable.
